name: exploratory-dinov2-partial-v3
amp: cuda_float16; CPU float32 for offline tests
optimizer: AdamW; constant LR; betas=(0.9,0.999); eps=1e-8; no decay for bias or norm
sample_weight: none; per-image mean cross entropy, no class weighting

augmentation.interpolation: bilinear; torchvision V1 RandomResizedCrop default, antialias=True

validation_transform: frozen protocol PIL EXIF/RGB bicubic resize and center crop at 336; model mean/std
selection: mean best validation macro-F1 across exactly three development folds; exact tie chooses smaller LR
epochs: max(2, rounded median of selected LR best epochs); fixed before all-development fit
rng: seed=protocol.seed+fold*10000 (full fit +900000); epoch seed=fit seed+epoch; separate epoch sampler generator; workers=0; interrupted epoch replayed

interpretation.status: EXPLORATORY development follow-up triggered by the initial frozen result; not preregistered untouched CV.
interpretation.validation: Best-epoch selection and LR selection use the same three all-development frozen-selector folds. These optimistic development scores are not unbiased CV or independent evidence.
interpretation.primary: Preserve frozen primary nested accuracy 0.793968 and macro-F1 0.79548 and ConvNeXt accuracy 0.68857. Fine-tuning does not overwrite or rebrand these results.
interpretation.candidate_choice: Compare selected fine-tune mean best validation macro-F1 with frozen selector 0.8035245993 only to inform final fresh-holdout candidate choice. Parent explicitly freezes the choice; both artifacts are retained.
interpretation.fresh_holdout: No access or scoring during development. Parent applies the frozen candidates to the same fresh holdout once after all configuration and candidate choices are frozen. Only that endpoint provides independent evidence; 80% is a target, not a promised outcome.
interpretation.failures: Six selection fits maximum, ten epochs maximum each; failed/interrupted/nonfinite/OOM attempts retained, no silent batch changes or added configurations. Resume replays only uncommitted epochs.
